name: marketplace
description: AI guidance marketplace — memory, roadmap, skills, and agents for Claude Code

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Project graph for Claude Code — code index (bulk, zero-LLM), episodic memory distilled from past transcripts (extractor haiku → arbiter sonnet), structured roadmap with backlog/claims/DoD, orchestrator + worker + roadmapper agents, via FalkorDB

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: File-based roadmap in native Claude Code auto memory — specs canon, milestones with DoD, stable task IDs and claims, mirrored to the repo (.claude/roadmap.md) for cross-machine portability. No MCP server required

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Fable → Opus orchestration — the non-coding model reframes, questions, scopes and splits the work, then delegates each scoped task to an Opus agent: mandatory canon + roadmap read gate before delegating, success criteria verified on return, and a closing ritual that captures the implicit into the canon
